schemes.name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.summary: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into bank accounts via DBT.
documents_required: Bank Account details (Aadhaar linked NPCI seeded)
schemes.application_method: Online Self-Registration / CSC Jan Seva Kendra
schemes.rule_explanation: Applicant must be a small/marginal farmer holding cultivable land up to 5 acres with annual household income under ₹3 Lakhs and not paying income tax.

action_plan_steps.title: Aadhaar e-KYC Verification
action_plan_steps.detail: Ensure your mobile number is linked to Aadhaar and OTP authentication is completed on pmkisan.gov.in.

action_plan_steps.title: Procure Land RoR (Khatauni)
action_plan_steps.detail: Obtain latest digitally signed Record of Rights (Khatauni) from your state Bhulekh portal or Tehsil.

action_plan_steps.title: Submit Farmers Registration
action_plan_steps.detail: Submit new farmer registration online or via nearest CSC Jan Seva Kendra with bank passbook.

action_plan_steps.title: Bank Account NPCI Seeding
action_plan_steps.detail: Confirm active NPCI DBT seeding with your bank branch for unhindered direct benefit transfers.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY
schemes.hindi_name: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
schemes.summary: Comprehensive health protection coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization across 27,000+ hospitals.

benefits.financial: ₹5,00,000 cashless health cover per family / year

documents_required: Ration Card (NFSA or State BPL Card)
schemes.estimated_effort: Online Instant (15 mins at Hospital / CSC)
schemes.rule_explanation: Families in SECC 2011 deprivation categories or holding valid state BPL/ration cards with household income under ₹2.5 Lakhs qualify for the Ayushman Golden Card.

action_plan_steps.title: Check Household Inclusion
action_plan_steps.detail: Search your family name on beneficiary.nha.gov.in using Ration card number or Aadhaar.

action_plan_steps.title: Biometric e-KYC Verification
action_plan_steps.detail: Visit nearest CSC Jan Seva Kendra or Ayushman Mitra desk at any government hospital with Aadhaar.

action_plan_steps.title: Generate Ayushman Golden Card
action_plan_steps.detail: Complete digital photo capture and download your personalized Ayushman PVC Card / digital copy.

action_plan_steps.title: Access Cashless Care
action_plan_steps.detail: Present your card at any of the 27,000+ empanelled public or private hospitals for zero-cash medical treatment.

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendors Scheme)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.summary: Affordable collateral-free working capital loan to urban street vendors starting at ₹10,000 up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy and digital cashback.

benefits.financial: ₹10,000 (1st Tranche) to ₹50,000 loan + 7% interest subsidy + ₹1,200/yr cashback

documents_required: Urban Local Body (ULB) Vending Certificate or Town Vending Committee (TVC) ID
schemes.application_method: Online Portal / Municipal Corporation (DUDA) / Lending Bank
schemes.rule_explanation: Urban street vendors engaged in vending in peri-urban or municipal limits who possess a vending certificate or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) qualify for collateral-free credit.

action_plan_steps.title: Procure Vending ID / LoR
action_plan_steps.detail: Obtain Certificate of Vending or apply for a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from your Town Vending Committee.

action_plan_steps.title: Submit Loan Application
action_plan_steps.detail: Apply on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in selecting your preferred local lending bank or microfinance institution.

action_plan_steps.title: Bank Loan Disbursement
action_plan_steps.detail: Complete minimal bank KYC formalities for direct credit of the first ₹10,000 working capital tranche.

action_plan_steps.title: Adopt Digital Payments
action_plan_steps.detail: Accept UPI QR payments to earn monthly cashback of up to ₹100 and qualify for higher loan limits.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
schemes.summary: Holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople: recognized PM Vishwakarma Certificate, ₹15,000 toolkit grant, and 5% concessional credit up to ₹3 Lakhs.

benefits.financial: ₹15,000 Toolkit Incentive + ₹1 Lakh (1st tranche) & ₹2 Lakhs (2nd tranche) loan at 5% interest

schemes.rule_explanation: Artisans aged 18+ working in one of the 18 recognized traditional family trades with self-employment and not availing similar government credit qualify.

action_plan_steps.title: Biometric CSC Enrollment
action_plan_steps.detail: Visit nearest CSC Jan Seva Kendra for Aadhaar biometric verification and trade declaration.

action_plan_steps.title: Gram Panchayat / ULB Verification
action_plan_steps.detail: Gram Panchayat Sachiv or Urban Ward Committee verifies your active practice of traditional trade.

action_plan_steps.title: Attend 5-Day Basic Skill Training
action_plan_steps.detail: Participate in 5 days of modern skill upgrade training with ₹500/day stipend.

action_plan_steps.title: Receive Toolkit Grant & Concessional Loan
action_plan_steps.detail: Receive ₹15,000 e-voucher for modern toolkits and apply for 5% collateral-free credit.

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.summary: Financial grant of ₹1,20,000 (plains) / ₹1,30,000 (hilly areas) for constructing a durable pucca house with toilet and clean cooking connection.

benefits.financial: ₹1,20,000 to ₹1,30,000 construction grant + ₹12,000 toilet grant + 90 days MGNREGA wages

documents_required: Photograph of existing kutcha dwelling site
schemes.application_method: Gram Sabha Selection / Awaas+ Portal Registration
schemes.rule_explanation: Rural households residing in kutcha houses or homeless status without pucca dwelling and meeting SECC deprivation criteria qualify for housing grant.

action_plan_steps.title: Gram Sabha List Inclusion
action_plan_steps.detail: Verify presence of your name in the Gram Panchayat Awaas+ permanent waitlist.

action_plan_steps.title: Site Geo-tagging & Physical Inspection
action_plan_steps.detail: Block Gram Rozgar Sevak inspects and uploads geo-tagged photo of existing kutcha house.

action_plan_steps.title: Sanction Order & First Installment
action_plan_steps.detail: Receive formal sanction letter and 1st tranche of ₹40,000 for plinth-level construction.

action_plan_steps.title: Completion & Swachh Bharat Toilet Grant
action_plan_steps.detail: Complete roof construction to receive final installments and ₹12,000 toilet grant.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
schemes.hindi_name: सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना (बेटी बचाओ, बेटी पढ़ाओ)
schemes.summary: High-interest (8.2%) government-backed sovereign savings scheme for girl children up to age 10 with Section 80C tax exemption and maturity at 21 years.

benefits.financial: 8.2% annual compound interest sovereign safe return + full tax exemption

schemes.application_method: Post Office / Public Sector Bank Branch
schemes.estimated_effort: Low (1 day at Post Office / Bank)
schemes.rule_explanation: Legal parents or guardians of a girl child below 10 years of age can open an account with initial deposit of ₹250 to secure her future education.

action_plan_steps.title: Collect Child's Birth Certificate
action_plan_steps.detail: Ensure you have the official birth certificate issued by municipal body or hospital.

action_plan_steps.title: Fill SSY Account Opening Form
action_plan_steps.detail: Collect Form-1 from nearest Post Office or authorized nationalized bank branch.

action_plan_steps.title: Initial Deposit & Passbook Minting
action_plan_steps.detail: Deposit minimum ₹250 cash/cheque along with parent KYC and child photo to receive SSY passbook.

action_plan_steps.title: Set Up Standing Deposit
action_plan_steps.detail: Deposit at least ₹250 each financial year to keep the 8.2% compounded interest account active.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
schemes.hindi_name: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना
schemes.summary: Monthly pension support directly into bank accounts for widowed women living below poverty line between ages 40 and 79.
documents_required: BPL Card or Valid Income Certificate (< ₹1,00,000/yr)
schemes.application_method: State Social Welfare Portal / Tehsil Office / CSC
schemes.rule_explanation: Widowed women aged 40-79 years belonging to households living below poverty line (BPL) qualify for monthly social security pension transfer.

action_plan_steps.title: Attest Husband's Death Certificate
action_plan_steps.detail: Ensure death certificate is officially verified and matches name in family ration register.

action_plan_steps.title: Submit Pension Dossier
action_plan_steps.detail: Submit application online on state social welfare portal (e.g. SSPY) or at Tehsil Lok Seva Kendra.

action_plan_steps.title: Tehsildar / Lekhpal Verification
action_plan_steps.detail: Local Patwari/Lekhpal verifies economic status and submits verification report to SDM.

action_plan_steps.title: Sanction Order & Monthly Credit
action_plan_steps.detail: Receive PPO (Pension Payment Order) number and verify first monthly credit via PFMS DBT.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (Shishu)
schemes.ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
schemes.summary: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹50,000 (Shishu) for micro-enterprises, small shopkeepers, tailors, and artisans with zero processing fees.

benefits.financial: Up to ₹50,000 collateral-free working capital loan at competitive bank interest rates

documents_required: Quotation / Cost estimate for business equipment or inventory
schemes.application_method: Udyamimitra Portal / Any Commercial or Grameen Bank Branch
schemes.rule_explanation: Micro-entrepreneurs and non-corporate, non-farm small businesses seeking credit up to ₹50,000 for income-generating activities qualify with zero collateral.

action_plan_steps.title: Prepare Business Activity Summary
action_plan_steps.detail: List the tools, inventory, or stock you plan to purchase with estimated vendor quotations.

action_plan_steps.title: Apply on Udyamimitra Portal
action_plan_steps.detail: Submit online MUDRA loan application or collect standard 1-page form from your local bank branch.

action_plan_steps.title: Bank Appraisal & Verification
action_plan_steps.detail: Bank branch manager reviews KYC, quotation, and conducts brief physical verification of shop/stall.

action_plan_steps.title: Loan Disbursement & MUDRA Card
action_plan_steps.detail: Sanctioned amount credited to account along with MUDRA RuPay Debit card for working capital cash withdrawal.

schemes.name: RTE Section 12(1)(c) Free School Admission
schemes.hindi_name: शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) - 25% निःशुल्क निजी स्कूल प्रवेश
schemes.summary: Mandatory 25% reserved seats in recognized private unaided schools for children from Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) and disadvantaged groups with zero tuition fees up to Class 8.

benefits.financial: 100% Free Tuition, Books, and Uniforms in nearby recognized private schools up to Class 8

documents_required: Domicile / Address proof within 1-3 km of school
Income Certificate (< ₹2 Lakhs) or Caste Certificate
schemes.application_method: State RTE Online Lottery Portal / District Education Office
schemes.rule_explanation: Children aged 3-7 years from families with annual income under ₹2 Lakhs or belonging to SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer are entitled to 25% free private school seats.

action_plan_steps.title: Obtain Valid Income / Caste Certificate
action_plan_steps.detail: Procure official Tahsil certificate certifying EWS status (< ₹2L) or disadvantaged category.

action_plan_steps.title: Submit State RTE Lottery Form
action_plan_steps.detail: Apply on your State RTE portal selecting up to 5 private schools within your residential neighborhood.

action_plan_steps.title: Lottery Results & School Allotment
action_plan_steps.detail: Check centralized computer lottery allocation sheet and download official allotment letter.

action_plan_steps.title: School Admission Verification
action_plan_steps.detail: Report to allotted private school with allotment letter for zero-fee admission and book issuance.

schemes.name: UP Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
schemes.hindi_name: उत्तर प्रदेश मुख्यमंत्री कन्या सुमंगला योजना
schemes.ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, UP
schemes.summary: Conditional cash transfer of ₹25,000 across 6 educational and developmental milestones from a girl child's birth to graduation.

benefits.financial: Total ₹25,000 grant disbursed in 6 developmental phases

schemes.rule_explanation: Permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh with annual family income under ₹3 Lakhs having up to two daughters qualify for milestone-based DBT assistance.

action_plan_steps.title: Verify UP Domicile & Income
action_plan_steps.detail: Ensure valid Niwas Praman Patra and Aay Praman Patra are on record in UP eDistrict.

action_plan_steps.title: Online Registration on MKSY Portal
action_plan_steps.detail: Create citizen login on mksy.up.gov.in and select appropriate developmental stage (Birth/Class 1/Class 6/etc.).

action_plan_steps.title: Block / DPO Verification
action_plan_steps.detail: District Probation Officer (DPO) and Block Development Officer digitally verify school/hospital certificates.

action_plan_steps.title: Direct Benefit Transfer Release
action_plan_steps.detail: Approved tranche amount credited directly to mother/father joint bank account via PFMS.

schemes.name: MP Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana
schemes.hindi_name: मध्य प्रदेश मुख्यमंत्री लाड़ली बहना योजना
schemes.ministry: Women and Child Development Department, MP
schemes.summary: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,250 transferred directly into the bank accounts of women residents aged 21-60 years.
documents_required: Samagra Family ID & Member ID (e-KYC completed)
schemes.application_method: Gram Panchayat / Ward Level Camp / Lok Seva Kendra
schemes.rule_explanation: Women aged 21-60 residing in Madhya Pradesh with Samagra e-KYC completed and family income under ₹2.5 Lakhs qualify for monthly ₹1,250 financial aid.

action_plan_steps.title: Complete Samagra e-KYC
action_plan_steps.detail: Ensure your Samagra ID is biometrically linked to your Aadhaar at nearest MP Lok Seva Kendra.

action_plan_steps.title: Activate Bank DBT Mandate
action_plan_steps.detail: Visit your bank branch and submit DBT consent form to ensure NPCI Aadhaar seeding is active.

action_plan_steps.title: Submit Application at Ward / GP Camp
action_plan_steps.detail: Attend special camp organized at Gram Panchayat or Municipal Ward office for instant form submission.

action_plan_steps.title: Track Monthly DBT Credit
action_plan_steps.detail: Receive SMS notification and direct ₹1,250 credit into your bank account on the 10th of every month.

schemes.name: e-Shram National Unorganized Workers Register
schemes.summary: Universal Account Number (UAN) with ₹2,00,000 accidental insurance cover under PMSBY and priority social security linkages during crises.

benefits.financial: ₹2 Lakh accidental death cover + Universal Account Number (UAN)

exclusions: Organized sector workers with EPFO or ESIC

documents_required: Bank Account details (Savings Bank Account No. & IFSC)
schemes.rule_explanation: Unorganized workers aged 16-59 not enrolled in EPFO/ESIC and not paying income tax qualify for instant national registry UAN card and social security cover.

action_plan_steps.title: Aadhaar OTP Authentication
action_plan_steps.detail: Visit eshram.gov.in and enter your Aadhaar-linked mobile number to receive OTP.

action_plan_steps.title: Declare Informal Occupation
action_plan_steps.detail: Select your informal sector occupation category (construction, agriculture, transport, etc.).

action_plan_steps.title: Bank Passbook Verification
action_plan_steps.detail: Verify bank account and IFSC code for future emergency relief and direct welfare benefit disbursements.

action_plan_steps.title: Download Universal UAN Card
action_plan_steps.detail: Download and print your 12-digit permanent e-Shram Universal Account Number (UAN) digital card.
